annotations.title: Get event price and volume history

description: Use when charting market probabilities or 24h volume for an event. Bounded windows carry the last prior snapshot forward. Kalshi market tickers select that market in its parent event's history.

event_id.description: Event id native to the source. A market ticker that extends its event id redirects to that event.

limit.description: Top-K markets, clamped to 1–50. markets_limit takes precedence.

market_id.description: Include this market even if it ranks outside the top set.

markets_limit.description: Maximum series including market_id. Takes precedence over limit.

max_points.description: Target maximum per series. Price gaps and endpoints are retained even when they exceed this number. Sampling can omit volume observations.

page_size.description: Alias for limit. Both values must agree.

name: get_event_history
title: Get event price and volume history
